item.title: Name
item.descriptionPlaceholder: Condition, what's included, how to pick it up
item.locationHint: Drag the pin, or press the map, to where the item is picked up. The pin is public — a nearby landmark is fine.
item.inactiveNote: This item is not being rented out right now.
item.missing: This item does not exist or has been removed.
item.photosHint: Up to 100 photos, compressed before upload. The first is the main photo and is shown on the map — press a photo to make it the main one.
item.locationName: A name for it — Home, the studio
item.locationOptional: Optional. Without one the item is not on the map, and is found by search and by its link.
item.availabilityHint: Tick the days of the week it can be had. On the calendar, press a date to close it, or to open one the days above leave out. Press the pencil beside a date's price to give it a default price of its own.
item.availabilityHintTime: Tick the days of the week it can be had. Press the pencil beside a date's price to give it a default price of its own.
item.previewNote: This is the booking page people will see. It is a preview: nothing is published until you press Publish in the form.
item.previewEmpty: There is nothing to preview. Open the item form and press Preview.
item.previewBlocked: The browser blocked the preview tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
item.ruleTimesWrong: A price rule's hours need a start before their end
item.hourRulesHint: The usual hours: the days they are for, and from when to when. Without any, only what is painted below can be booked.
item.hoursRequired: Say which hours it can be booked
item.hoursHint: What the hours above come to in the week shown; the arrows turn to another week. Drag to paint hours for one date only; drag from a painted spot to erase. Scroll with the column of times on the left.
item.unitHint: The shortest stretch that can be booked, and the step a longer one grows by. Available hours and price time ranges are still set on the half hour.

modeHint.day: Booked by the day, priced per day.
modeHint.time: Booked for a day and a stretch of hours.

pricingHint.day: What an ordinary day costs. To price one date differently, press the pencil beside it on the calendar below.
pricingHint.time: The default price, for the stretch of time picked under “Price per” — which can differ from the booking step: priced per hour and booked by 15 minutes, a 15-minute booking costs a quarter of it. To price one date differently, press the pencil beside it on the calendar below.

item.datePriceHint: Left empty, this date costs the overall default price.
item.extraRates_one: {{count}} earlier price rule is still in force.
item.extraRates_other: {{count}} earlier price rules are still in force.
item.slotPriceHint: Left empty, this time costs what the date does.

gate.body: rab shows what is for rent around you. Allow location so the map can open where you are.
gate.deniedHint: Allow this site to use your location, then try again. On iPhone: turn on Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services and set “Safari Websites” to “While Using the App”, or tap the aA button in the address bar > Website Settings > Location > Allow. Until then the map stays on your country’s capital.
gate.failedHint: The device gave no position. Check that Location Services are on and you have signal, then try again.
gate.insecure: This page cannot get your location
gate.insecureHint: Browsers only give a position to pages on https or localhost. Open rab at an https address.

kind.serviceHint: Your time: photography, lessons, repairs, a guide.

share.title: Share

cancel.days_other: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} days before it starts.
cancel.late: It is too late to cancel this booking.

cancel.hours_one: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} hour before it starts.
cancel.hours_other: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} hours before it starts.

review.explainRental: This booking is complete. How was it with {{name}}, and how was the item? Your ratings and comment are shown on their profile and on the item's page.
